mu_name_from: MuMain draws Loch's Feather at +1 as MODEL_EVENT+16 = Data\Item\DarkLordSleeve.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1015; ZzzObject.cpp:6174-6177; ZzzInventory.cpp:10483-10485) and names it the Crest of Monarch (ZzzInventory.cpp:6579-6581). Ours is its own row, group 13 number 6, a number MU leaves empty (the user, 2026-10-25, docs/plans/dark-lord-gear.md "Decided" 3: "its own item row").
why_this_one: The Cape of Lord's ingredient: the 2nd wings' mix with the Crest in Loch's Feather's place (WebZen 1.00.93 MixSystem.cpp WingChaosMix:2545-2553; docs/plans/dark-lord-cape.md section 2).
profile_note: As Loch's Feather: a small object in the bag and on the ground.
tells: Mix with a 1st level wing and a Jewel of Chaos to make the Cape of Lord
tells_from: Ours: MU prints the feather's 'Used to upgrade wings' under it too (GT 748, ZzzInventory.cpp:4384), and the Crest makes the cape alone. The recipe in full (the user, 2026-10-26: 'fix weak points' -- nothing told a player where the Crest goes). Its name purple as the feather's (game/ui/describe.cpp, Tone::Quest).
ground_note: MuMain lays it at angle 45 and scale 0.5 (ZzzObject.cpp:5806-5810) and turns it (-90, 0, 0) in the bag (ZzzInventory.cpp:8222-8225); ours lays every drop by its bounds (game/fx/litter.cpp) and frames every bag model by them, so neither number is carried. It stands in the feather's violet column on the ground.
effects_note: No effect in MuMain: no glow, chrome, sprite or light names MODEL_EVENT+16 outside the model swap.

stats.note: Ours: Loch's Feather's row (13/14) at its own number, as it is that feather at +1 in MU. Not in the ordinary drop -- it falls on its own roll beside the feather's, where the feather does (sim::crestOfMonarch, sim::kFeatherOdds; the user, 2026-10-25: "our Loch's Feather rule").
stats.from: OpenMU VersionSeasonSix/Items/Wings.cs CreateFeather (DropLevel 78, 1x2, Durability 1); Maps/Icarus.cs:39-47 drops it as the feather at ItemLevel 1.

sheet_from: Data/Item/DarkLordSleeve.OZT (32x64, opaque): a blue banner with a gold sun crest above a gold sprig, rounded gold-edged ends. Decoded from MuMain with pipeline/decode_texture.py.
sheet_materials_from: An embroidered cloth sleeve, judged from the sheet.
